title: OSHA crane signal person qualifications practice questions
description: Practice questions on who must qualify crane signal persons, the two options, documentation, re-assessment and the requirements (29 CFR 1926.1428).

questions.topic: Who must make sure, and when
questions.question: Under 1926.1428(a), whose duty is it to ensure that each signal person meets the Qualification Requirements?

options.A: The crane operator who receives the signals
options.B: The employer of the signal person

questions.explanation: Paragraph (a) states: "The employer of the signal person must ensure that each signal person meets the Qualification Requirements (paragraph (c) of this section) prior to giving any signals."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Who must make sure, and when
questions.question: By what point does 1926.1428(a) require a signal person to meet the Qualification Requirements?

options.A: Within 30 days of starting work as a signal person
options.B: Before the end of the first project
options.D: Before the equipment's next annual inspection

questions.explanation: The employer must ensure each signal person meets the Qualification Requirements "prior to giving any signals."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(a) says the requirement must be met "using either Option (1) or Option (2)". Which pair names those two options?

options.A: Documentation from a third party qualified evaluator, or an assessment by the employer's qualified evaluator
options.B: A State signal person license, or a union apprenticeship card
options.C: A sign-off by the crane operator, or a sign-off by the lift director
options.D: Training from the crane manufacturer, or a pre-lift meeting

questions.explanation: The options are "Option (1)—Third party qualified evaluator" and "Option (2)—Employer's qualified evaluator."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under Option (1) in 1926.1428(a)(1), what must the third party qualified evaluator's documentation show?

options.A: The number of hours the signal person has worked near cranes
options.B: That the signal person also holds crane operator certification
options.C: The rated capacity of each crane the signal person will direct
options.D: That the signal person meets the Qualification Requirements

questions.explanation: Under Option (1), "The signal person has documentation from a third party qualified evaluator ... showing that the signal person meets the Qualification Requirements (see paragraph (c) of this section)."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under Option (2) in 1926.1428(a)(2), what does the employer's qualified evaluator do?

options.A: Sends the assessment results to the OSHA area office for approval
options.B: Assesses the individual, determines that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements and provides documentation of that determination
options.C: Registers the signal person with an accredited testing organization
options.D: Watches the signal person for one shift and gives a verbal approval

questions.explanation: Under Option (2), the employer's qualified evaluator "assesses the individual and determines that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements (see paragraph (c) of this section) and provides documentation of that determination."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A signal person was assessed by Employer A's own qualified evaluator under Option (2) and then goes to work for Employer B. Under 1926.1428(a)(2), may Employer B use that assessment to meet the section's requirements?

options.A: Yes, if Employer B keeps a copy at the site
options.B: Yes, for up to one year after the assessment
options.C: No, because an assessment by an employer's qualified evaluator under Option (2) is not portable
options.D: Yes, if Employer B uses the same type of signals

questions.explanation: "An assessment by an employer's qualified evaluator under this option is not portable—other employers are not permitted to use it to meet the requirements of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 1926.1428(a)(3), where must the employer make the signal person's qualification documentation available?

options.A: At the site while the signal person is employed by the employer
options.B: At the employer's head office only
options.C: With the OSHA area office before work begins

questions.explanation: Paragraph (a)(3): "The employer must make the documentation for whichever option is used available at the site while the signal person is employed by the employer."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: What must the qualification documentation specify under 1926.1428(a)(3)?

options.A: The signal person's years of construction experience
options.B: The cranes on site and their rated capacities
options.C: The name of every operator the signal person has worked with
options.D: Each type of signaling for which the signal person meets the requirements of paragraph (c)

questions.explanation: "The documentation must specify each type of signaling (e.g. hand signals, radio signals, etc.) for which the signal person meets the requirements of paragraph (c) of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: To which option does the documentation duty in 1926.1428(a)(3) apply?

options.B: Whichever option is used, Option (1) or Option (2)
options.D: Neither option when the signal person is a direct employee

questions.explanation: The employer must make "the documentation for whichever option is used" available at the site.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: When a signal person falls short
questions.question: Under 1926.1428(b), what triggers the employer's duty to stop an individual from continuing to work as a signal person?

options.A: Subsequent actions by the signal person indicate that the individual does not meet the Qualification Requirements
options.B: The signal person has not given signals for 30 days
options.C: The crane is moved to a new site
options.D: A new operator starts work on the crane

questions.explanation: Paragraph (b) applies "If subsequent actions by the signal person indicate that the individual does not meet the Qualification Requirements".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: When a signal person falls short
questions.question: Once 1926.1428(b) applies, what must happen before the employer may allow the individual to continue working as a signal person?

options.A: A second signal person is assigned to watch the first one
options.B: The individual signs a written warning
options.C: Re-training is provided and a re-assessment in accordance with paragraph (a) confirms that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements

questions.explanation: The employer "must not allow the individual to continue working as a signal person until re-training is provided and a re-assessment is made in accordance with paragraph (a) of this section that confirms that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 1926.1428(c)(1), if hand signals are used, what must the signal person know and understand?

options.A: The hand signals printed in the crane's load chart
options.C: Hand signals chosen by the controlling entity
options.D: The Standard Method for hand signals

questions.explanation: "If hand signals are used, the signal person must know and understand the Standard Method for hand signals."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(c)(2) requires each signal person to be competent in what?

options.A: The application of the type of signals used

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Be competent in the application of the type of signals used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(c)(3) requires a basic understanding of equipment operation and limitations. What does it say that understanding includes?

options.A: Calculating ground bearing pressure under the outriggers
options.B: The crane dynamics involved in swinging and stopping loads and boom deflection from hoisting loads

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Have a basic understanding of equipment operation and limitations, including the crane dynamics involved in swinging and stopping loads and boom deflection from hoisting loads."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 1926.1428(c)(4), the relevant requirements of which sections must a signal person know and understand?
questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Know and understand the relevant requirements of §§ 1926.1419 through 1926.1422 and 1926.1428."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: How does 1926.1428(c)(5) say a signal person must demonstrate that the requirements in (c)(1) through (4) are met?

options.C: Through an oral or written test, and through a practical test
options.D: Through a signed statement from the crane operator

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Demonstrate that he/she meets the requirements in paragraphs (c)(1) through (4) of this section through an oral or written test, and through a practical test."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)
